'''Banley''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]] during the [[Separatist War]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. He was wounded, and was in the infirmary of [[Mannett Point]] when a [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|member]] of [[Havoc Squad]] infiltrated the base; another wounded, [[Jex (Separatist)|Jex]], was able to convince the [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] to leave them in peace.
